units.source_text: 3O日晨，副司给安装这装置的工厂挂了电话，请他们来修理。

en.t: On the morning of the 30th, the deputy priest telephoned the factory that had installed the device and asked them to come repair it.

units.source_text: 好心的老向导还特地把这件事告诉了我。

en.t: The kind old guide even went out of his way to tell me about it.

units.source_text: 昨夜正是断然行动的好机会，我又错过这千载难逢的时机了。

en.t: Last night had been the perfect chance to act decisively, and once again I had missed this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
